title: Varney the vampyre; or, the feast of blood
sourceTitle: Varney the vampyre; or, the feast of blood
author: Thomas Peckett Prest · James Malcolm Rymer
description: "Varney the Vampire; Or, the Feast of Blood" by Prest and Rymer is a serialized gothic horror story published between 1845-1847.
longDescription: This sprawling penny dreadful follows the vampire Sir Francis Varney as he terrorizes the impoverished Bannerworth family.

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Peckett Prest · James Malcolm Rymer (1810–1859) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include The String of Pearls; Or, The Barber of Fleet Street. A Domestic Romance.. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
